newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst merges its insurance activities.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst merges its insurance activities.

text.p: German chemicals and drugs group Hoechst AG on Tuesday said it is merging all of its insurance activities into one unit, called Hoechst Versicherungs AG.

Hoechst Versicherungs AG (HVAG), a wholly owned Hoechst subsidiary, will participate as a primary insurer and reinsurer for the Hoechst group, insuring property, loss of revenue and liability claims, the group said in a statement.

Hoechst, which recently announced plans to transform the group into a strategic holding company by separating its units into individual legal entities, said this particular restructuring will help lower risk and financing costs for the group.
